title: Virological validation of finger-stick whole blood HIV self-test Exacto® Test HIV
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iypcfvn

steps.title: Perform HIV self-test
steps.instruction: Conduct the Exacto® Test HIV finger-stick whole blood self-test with participants and have the results read by a healthcare professional.

steps.title: Perform initial serological screening
steps.instruction: Carry out serological HIV testing following the WHO II algorithm using two tests in series.

substeps.instruction: Perform Alere Determine™ HIV-1/2 (Alere Medical Co. Ltd., Matsudo-shi, Chiba-ken, Japan) as the first test.
Perform Uni-Gold TM HIV (Trinity Biotech Manufacturing Ltd., Bray, Co. Wicklow, Ireland) as the second confirmatory test.

steps.title: Re-test positive and indeterminate samples
steps.instruction: In the reference laboratory, re-test all positive and indeterminate samples from the initial WHO II screening on plasma according to the 2012-revised, 2015-consolidated WHO strategy for HIV testing.

substeps.instruction: Perform Alere Determine™ HIV-1/2 (Alere Medical Co. Ltd.) and Uni-Gold TM HIV (Trinity Biotech Manufacturing Ltd.) as the first two HIV tests.
Perform recomLine HIV-1 & HIV-2 ® IgG (Biosynex) as the third HIV test.

steps.title: Assess HIV viral load
steps.instruction: Assess HIV viral load via molecular biology on plasma samples.

substeps.instruction: Process all HIV-seropositive or indeterminate samples.
Process 1 out of 2 randomly selected HIV-seronegative plasmas.
